name: a bag of loose screws
note: Rattles like teeth.

name: a spent battery
note: Still faintly warm.

name: a vending machine coin
note: The machines down here still take it.

name: a subway token
note: For a line that was never built.

name: a burned-out circuit board
note: Smells of ozone and incense.

name: a neon tube fragment
note: Flickers pink in the dark.

name: a tangle of fiber cable
note: It glows when nobody looks.

name: a scratched data disc
note: Labelled in a hand you almost know.

name: an ID card, face scratched
note: Clearance level: none.

name: a moth-eaten glove
note: Too small for any hand you know.

name: a bead of smoky glass
note: Something moves inside it.

name: a cracked hand mirror
note: Shows a room that isn't here.

name: a vial of medicine
note: Heals everyone by a third.

name: a strip of prayer cloth
note: Raises fallen allies a little.

name: a stub of black candle
note: Burns for a while. Calms the room.

name: a tin of old matches
note: Half of them still strike.

name: a coil of copper wire
note: Good for something. Probably.

name: a dead pager
note: It buzzes once, every new moon.

name: a cracked phone
note: The screen shows a map of somewhere else.

name: a cassette with no label
note: Hiss, then breathing.

name: a VR visor, lens cracked
note: Shows the room, but emptier.

name: a rusted iron key
note: It opens nothing here.

name: a bent silver charm
note: Warm to the touch at night.

name: a page of a burned book
note: One line survives: "down is not away."

name: a rune scratched into a circuit board
note: Nobody taught the scratcher to read either language. It still works.

name: a salt-crusted network cable
note: Whatever it carried, it carried something else too.

name: a candle stub in a soda can
note: Somebody's shrine, somebody's lunch.

name: a charm bracelet of old keycards
note: Every card opened a door that isn't there now.

name: a rosary of fiber optic beads
note: It lights up one bead per prayer.

name: a sealed jar, humming faintly
note: The label peeled off years ago. The hum changes pitch when you lie.

name: a SIM card in red thread
note: The number still rings. Nobody answers.

name: a graffiti-stained saint's medal
note: Somebody tagged a saint. The saint didn't mind.

name: a bullet casing on a leather cord
note: Worn by someone who knew what it stopped.

name: a keycard, one corner burned
note: Level 9. There is no level 9.

name: an old COMP chip
note: Its last program is still running, very slowly.

name: a black pearl
note: It reflects the wrong room.

name: a jar of grave salt
note: Spirits don't like it.

name: a wax seal, unbroken
note: Pressed with a sigil you don't know.

name: a chipped bone die
note: Always lands on six.

name: a sealed reliquary
note: Something inside knocks, politely.

name: a ring of red gold
note: Heavier than it should be.

name: a sword in a rotted sheath
note: The blade is clean. It always was.

name: a moonstone
note: Cold, and full of light that isn't from here.

name: a shard of pale moonlight
note: It casts a shadow of its own.

name: a fang still warm
note: Whatever it came from is still looking for it.

name: a silver-veined horn
note: Hums a note only the moon can hear.
